metadata.label: SSI reflectance
metadata.coverage: Two Galileo green-filter photographs cover Ida from different approach positions. Their calibrated brightness retains the original illumination. The grid marks gaps and rejected pixels.

celestial.sunSource: Pinned JPL Horizons heliocentric elements and the source mission body-fixed rotation model

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.notes: Thomas’s registered Galileo mosaic combines detailed images with a coarser background. Its high-pass processing reduces broad brightness differences but retains photographed shading and seams; it is not calibrated albedo. Source sampling varies greatly. Gray grid marks source-defined unprojectable surfaces. Shadows adds approximate fixed-epoch Sun lighting.

controls.label: SSI reflectance
controls.notes: These two Galileo photographs show overlapping parts of Ida’s surface. Both were taken through a green filter. The original sunlight and shadows remain visible; the grid marks areas without usable photographs.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.notes: Color shows source radius minus a 16 km reference sphere, including Ida’s broad irregular shape. This is radial height, not gravitational elevation. Brightness adds cartographic relief derived from the 2° shape grid; the displayed silhouette is simplified. Shadows adds approximate fixed-epoch Sun lighting.
